name: Plesk
line: Manage websites and databases with a panel installed on your server.

free.text: 14-day license trial, no card; once per person/server; provide server

cells.selfhost: Yes; install on your own server

work.math: The 2026 Web Admin license is $16.99 a month. The VPS, 100 GB of data sent out, builds and domain registration are separate and not priced.
The 2026 license is $16.99 a month. A server with 1 vCPU and 1 GiB, and its transfer, are not priced, so the workload total is unknown.

work.plan: Web Pro VPS license + server + PostgreSQL
work.math: The 2026 Web Pro license is $29.99 a month. The server, database storage and remote 7-day backups are not priced. The license alone is not a workload total.
